findings.claim: The archive/delete/unarchive session-scope handlers set HX-Redirect unconditionally, so on any error the browser redirects and discards the rendered error fragment, silently hiding failures on all three operations.
findings.fix: Set HX-Redirect only when err == nil (one shared fix for all three handlers), mirroring the runRepoOp pattern in internal/server/repos.go that sets its trigger header conditionally and otherwise lets the fragment render the error in place.

findings.claim: The superseded plan's Changelog, Changes, Verification, and Contracts sections were never updated to record that Phase A's prompt-string-only mechanism was dropped and replaced by change-headless-bootstrap.md's wrapper-orchestrated design, misleading a reader into believing the old mechanism shipped.
findings.fix: Append a Changelog row to change-bootstrap-profile.md pointing at change-headless-bootstrap.md and marking Phase A superseded, per RULE-PLAN-049.

findings.claim: The newly added test TestProposalsGroupTitlesNonDeveloper kept the stale NonDeveloper identifier despite the casual rename sweep, though its body already uses the new audience: casual fixture value.
The new loadedModTime and loadedSize fields are inserted between mu and repos, breaking the alphabetical field ordering of Registry's guarded-state block required by RULE-GOLANG-STRUCT-002.
findings.fix: Sort the new fields before mu: loadedModTime, loadedSize, mu, repos.

findings.claim: startPeek's backLink parameter and the --back-link flag passed to the spawned peek-mcp process are not documented in the multi-profile-ports plan's Phase 2 Changes list, making it an untracked addition against that plan.
findings.fix: Add a one-line note in the plan's Changelog explaining where --back-link came from, per ACTION-REVIEW-SPEC-005.
